entities.name: Lawrence O'Bryan Branch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lawrence O'Bryan Branch was an American politician who served as a representative for North Carolina in the U.S. Congress and a Confederate brigadier general in the American Civil War. He was killed in action at the Battle of Antietam.
